--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1,19 @@
 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+The test suite runs with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or a single test with:
+
+```bash
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
+
+Add `-v` for per-test output and `-x` to stop at the first failure.
